method.description: Historical daily replay of the Early Watch surfaced shortlist. Daily Review First candidates from all four batches are merged, sorted by the frozen Early Watch score, and capped at six. No quota is filled.
method.candidateSource: All daily Early Watch Review First candidates from all four universe batches.
method.repeatedNames: pickDayObservations reflects what the user would actually see each day. firstSurfaceEpisodes removes consecutive-day repeats.
method.holdout: Recent holdout is the last 30% of chronological scan dates; no threshold is refit on holdout outcomes.
method.capTest: On days with more than six eligible names, topSixOnCrowdedDays is compared with excludedBelowSix to test whether score ordering adds value rather than merely reducing workload.
method.rankingTest: Two small outcome-blind ranking variants are compared with the frozen baseline. Eligibility and max-six policy remain unchanged; success requires better top-3 vs ranks 4-6 separation, especially on the recent chronological holdout.
